sql.if: AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(role_code)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(name, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(description, ''))) > 0)

mapper.select: SELECT r.*, p.permission_code AS linked_permission_code FROM (SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY role_code ASC LIMIT #{pageable.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageable.offset}) r LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_code = r.role_code LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code ORDER BY r.role_code ASC, p.permission_code ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(enabled = true), 0) AS enabled_count, COALESCE(SUM(system_role = true), 0) AS system_count FROM sys_role WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, name, description, system_role, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{systemRole}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, system_role = #{systemRole}, enabled = #{enabled}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{id})
